decisions.reason: The semi-hard cheese wheel is close to the firm's established offer and its demand remains uncertain; keeping the option costs little and the firm holds few other options, so the option value justifies keeping it.

Spicy cheese is a differentiated variant building on the established offer; absent clear evidence of resolved low value, the option is still worth retaining given low carrying costs and limited alternative options.
The mild creamy soft cheese is a branded addition close to the core offer; its limited website presence after 2019 is not enough to conclude the option has resolved, so the firm should keep it.
